exploratory_design_se.limitation: Plug-in finite-population stratified SE; n=5 strata can yield zero sample variance despite genuine uncertainty. Do not construct a Wald CI from this alone.

conservative_sampling_bounds.explanation: Finite-population hypergeometric inversion; each endpoint interval uses Bonferroni across 20 strata. The strict lower and optimistic upper together also give a conservative 95% envelope covering sampling uncertainty plus ambiguity endpoints. Wide bounds are intentional. Coverage concerns the random sample of this saved run, conditional on fixed case judgments, not run-to-run randomness or reviewer validity.

strata.label: organization based or located in
strata.definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: Explicit headquarters, campus, office and based-in evidence qualify. Company/firm modified by a city may express location. Nationality-only adjectives are ambiguous; corporate-family and Internet-sector membership, events and personal activity alone do not qualify.

strata.label: managerial or leadership office in
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or political body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Head, president, leader, chair, dean, director or executive roles qualify, including offices within an organization. Professors, experts, scientists, generic employment, founding and spokesperson roles alone do not. Historical tenure counts.

strata.label: defeated opponent
strata.definition: Competitor X defeated opposing competitor Y in a completed sporting or electoral contest.
strata.scope_notes: Beat, defeat, sweep, outlast, rout, upset and explicit victories qualify. Mere playing, facing, standings leads, transfers and losses do not. Historical win evidence suffices even with other losses; geographic team metonymy needs clear competitive roles.

strata.label: managerial or leadership office in
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or political body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Chair, executive, head, chief and equivalent leadership qualify. Founder, owner, partner, generic employment, meetings and nomination alone do not establish tenure; historical office counts.

strata.label: spokesperson for
strata.definition: Person X serves or served as a spokesperson for principal Y, including a person, organization or public office.
strata.scope_notes: Explicit spokesman, spokeswoman, speaking-for and identified principal-office representation qualify. Director, secretary, adviser, aide, lobbyist, manager and generic employment alone do not. Statements to Y are not representation of Y.

strata.label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
strata.definition: Organization X is a subsidiary, division or organizational unit of Y.
strata.scope_notes: Explicit unit, subsidiary, division, parent or owned-by qualify, including historical ownership. Mere affiliation, employee roles, geographic places and reverse ownership do not. City-as-office metonymy requires review.

strata.label: analyst at organization
strata.definition: Person X works or worked as an analyst for organization Y.
strata.scope_notes: Explicit analyst-at/with/for and following an industry for an employer qualify. Economist-only, forecaster or specialist descriptions remain ambiguous under the prior analyst boundary. Director, president, lobbyist, partner and generic employment alone do not.

strata.label: winner or champion of
strata.definition: X won the competition or award designated by Y, or held its championship title.
strata.scope_notes: The win/champion/winner dictionary includes sports and honor-award uses. Explicit titles designated by sanctioning bodies qualify. Participation, qualifying, reaching an event and event-stage victory without overall title alone do not. Historical wins count.

strata.label: athlete plays for team
strata.definition: Athlete X plays or has played for sports team Y.
strata.scope_notes: Selected after inspecting the entire relation: player/team positions, scoring-for and athletic team membership form the largest coherent subgroup behind the overloaded lead and give paths. Explicit player, center, wing, guard, scorer and playing/scoring-for qualify. Competitive leads over opponents, coaching/management, political leadership, communication, support, constitutional powers and disease are competing meanings, not additions to this predicate.

strata.label: managerial or leadership office in
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in organization or governing body Y.
strata.scope_notes: President, head, leader, chair, director, chief, executive, commissioner and equivalent organizational office qualify, including leadership within Y. Founder, partner, reporter, generic membership, location and athletic leads alone do not; historical tenure counts.

strata.label: directed communication to
strata.definition: X directs information, speech, a request, warning or advice to addressee Y.
strata.scope_notes: Tell, urge, ask, notify, persuade, address, testify-before and speaking-to qualify. Meeting, cooperation, statements about Y and physical transfers alone do not. Send/submit/give with no object are ambiguous unless other rows establish communication.

strata.label: lives or has lived in
strata.definition: Person X or members of population X live or have lived in geographic place Y.
strata.scope_notes: The strongest repeated live-in paths define residence, including explicit home, residency, resettlement and being raised there. Visiting, arriving, transit, employment, officeholding, death location and other temporary presence alone do not qualify. Population statements concern members rather than every member.

strata.label: moves or travels to
strata.definition: X undertakes travel, relocation, return or other movement with geographic destination Y.
strata.scope_notes: Direction is traveler or relocating organization to destination. Moving/returning/arriving and leaving for Y qualify. Leaving from Y, mere presence, sports event participation, ownership and professional affiliation do not. Military invasion-only cases retain the previous explicit scope ambiguity.

strata.label: member of organization or political body
strata.definition: X is or has been a member of organization, alliance, party or public body Y.
strata.scope_notes: The join/member/entry/membership paths define membership, including countries in alliances and individual legislators. Mere negotiation to join, geographical entry, allies of individual countries, political party control of a legislature and criticism of another body do not automatically establish membership. Membership of unnamed individual party members is not membership of their party as a single institution.

strata.label: owns organization or asset
strata.definition: Person or organization X owns or has owned organization, business, team or asset Y, wholly or partly.
strata.scope_notes: Owner, co-owner, parent, subsidiary and explicit acquisition/ownership support qualify, including historical ownership and stated shares. Management, leadership, publication/distribution alone, merger proposals without completion, and location are distinct.

strata.label: president or manager office in
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or public body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Preserves the previous president-plus-manager scope. President and manager descriptions, including historical service, qualify. Executive, chair, director, coach, generic leadership, employment and ownership alone do not.

strata.label: coach of
strata.definition: Person X coaches or has coached sports team or collegiate program Y.
strata.scope_notes: Explicit coach descriptions or direct coaching qualify, including dismissed/former tenure. University/team shorthand may identify the program. Manager, president, player, spokesperson, generic employment or presence alone do not.

strata.label: lives or has lived in
strata.definition: Person X lives or has lived in geographic location Y.
strata.scope_notes: This highly mixed dictionary was inspected together with all 32 relation facts before selection. Its largest recurring place-oriented family comprises obituary-style personal-name/of-city paths and explicit home/live-in paths; the directional residence criterion is retained without merging it with workplace location. Explicit residence/home qualifies. Bare son/brother apposition to a city needs attachment review; professional practice, company location, generic presence and organizational leadership alone are different predicates.

strata.label: president or manager office in
strata.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or public body Y.
strata.scope_notes: Manager paths dominate, preserving the earlier president-plus-manager scope. Explicit manager or president roles and historical tenure qualify. Coach, director, chair, researcher, athlete and ordinary employment alone do not establish this narrower office.

strata.label: directed communication to
strata.definition: X directs information, speech, a request, warning or advice to addressee Y.
strata.scope_notes: Ask, urge, tell, notify, address and message-to qualify. Replacing/firing a predecessor, taking office, athletic defeat, support and physical transfers alone do not. Send with no object is ambiguous unless another case-local row supplies clear communication.
